column1: # Template for the next allocation (scripts/campaign.sh replaces {R}). Plan (10-21 18:35, after the 7th preemption cut the
# first repro at 51 min): A/B first, on a deployment whose prefill already carries the EAGLE flags (no decode drift between
# the two rounds, ../RESULT §2.13): weight 0 (= PR 210's token-only decode demand) then 180,000 tokens per held request,
# router = PR 210 + --decode-request-weight in both, prefill flushed before each. Then the exact PR 210 repro on a fresh
# deployment of the unmodified kit (prefill without MTP, the image's router).
run pr210/kit_round.sh RUN=k{R} VARIANT=k{R}-pmtp-w0 CONC=88 ROUTER=exp WEIGHT=0
run pr210/kit_round.sh RUN=k{R} VARIANT=k{R}-pmtp-w180k CONC=88 ROUTER=exp WEIGHT=180000
run pr210/kit_round.sh RUN=k{R}r VARIANT=k{R}-repro CONC=88 ROUTER=image
